purpose: Local synthetic polarity/noise stress corpus; prevent no-experience becoming automatic experience follow-up
limitations: One TTS voice; not a real non-native speaker, physical microphone, room, or Quest benchmark.
Inserted pauses, written hesitation and attenuated critical words are artificial acoustic stress, not a modeled nationality/accent.
Noise is procedurally synthesized, not recorded ventilation/keyboard audio. SNR is a controlled signal ratio, not a measured real-room sound level.
Critical intervals use TTS word onsets, not manually verified phoneme alignment. Both positive and negative minimal-pair words receive the same attenuation rule.
0dB mixed noise and critical-word attenuation are combined, so effects cannot be attributed to either one independently.
Gold is the known synthesis input even when audio becomes unintelligible. The safety target is clarify/retry rather than inferring missing meaning.
These 32 fixtures do not establish general Korean ASR accuracy or human learner outcomes.

evaluation.primaryFailure: forbidAutoExperience=true but application takes an automatic experience follow-up
evaluation.reviewAction: For ambiguous/noisy critical polarity, clarify or retry is safer than unsupported automatic branching.
